Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX.4.2 or FIX.4.4 Must be the first field in the message. FIX 4.4 only available if the port is dedicated for trade reporting purposes.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Length of message following BodyLength field up to and including the de- limiter preceding the CheckSum (10) field. Must be the second field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Must be the third field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequential sequence number for the session.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Indicates a message resent from the admin level (has a duplicate sequence number). Defaults to N.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: ID of sender. Assigned by Cboe for messages sent to Cboe. (TargetCompID (56) for messages from Cboe.)

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: GMT date and time that message was sent. Microsecond level resolution.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: ID of destination. BATS for messages sent to BXE ports. CHIX for messages sent to CXE ports. CEUX for messages sent to DXE ports. (SenderCompID (49) for messages from Cboe.)

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Sub ID of destination. TEST for messages sent to the Cboe test system. PROD for messages sent to the Cboe production system. (SenderSubID (50) for messages from Cboe.)

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Possible resend flag. Cboe has special handling for the PossResend for New Order Single messages. See New Order — Single below.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: Service bureau use. Identifies end-client on messages to Cboe. Must be identifier known to Cboe. May be used by non-service bureau to specify which clearing arrangement to use if multiple are configured.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfSubID
Field.Description: End-client sub identifier. Four characters, alphanumeric, otherwise not validated. Recorded and re- turned in DeliverToSubID (129). Available via Drop.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: For messages with PossDupFlag (43) = Y, indicates time that message was first sent. Microsecond level resolution.

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: Service bureau use. Identifies end-client on message from Cboe. Must be Cboe approved identifier.

Field.Name: DeliverToSubID
Field.Description: Returns OnBehalfOfSubID (116) optionally sent by client.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Modulo 256 checksum of all characters in the message up to and including the delimiter preceding the CheckSum field. Three digits with leading zeroes if necessary.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Optional. Returned on execution reports associated with this order. 16 characters or less (ASCII 33–126). H: and C: prefix can be used to specify which CCP Account to use. If configured by Cboe: House or Client CCP account can be defaulted. OrderCapacity (47) is no longer used to determine which CCP account to use. The value supplied can be passed to the CCP and made available on the Drop feed.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Day-unique ID chosen by client. 20 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33–126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe. If the ClOrdID matches a live order, it will be rejected as duplicate (unless PossResend (97) = Y; see above). Note: Cboe only enforces the uniqueness of ClOrdID values among currently live orders. However, we strongly recommend that you keep your ClOrdID values day unique.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Required if IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN). If Currency (15) is included when other symbology is used, it must match the currency expected by Cboe for the given symbol.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Single value only (with no trailing space). P = Market Peg (peg buy to PBBO offer, peg sell to PBBO bid) R = Primary Peg (peg buy to PBBO bid, peg sell to PBBO offer) M = Midpoint (peg to PBBO midpoint) L = Alternate Midpoint (less aggressive of midpoint and 1 tick inside PBBO) for Periodic Auction Orders:6 M = Midpoint (peg to Cboe EBBO midpoint) G = Guarded Midpoint (peg to Cboe EBBO midpoint but suspend order if primary market quote becomes one-sided or disappears) NOTE: Values L and G differ in meaning from standard FIX 4.2. All other values are ignored. Midpoint pegged orders (M and L) are implicitly hidden (DisplayIndicator (9479) = I).

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Values supported by Cboe: 4 = ISIN 5 = RIC Required if Symbol (55) is not set.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of shares for the order. System-wide limit is 99,999,999 shares.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: 1 = Market 2 = Limit P = Pegged During continuous trading Market (1) implies TimeInForce (59) = 3 (IOC). Pegged requires ExecInst (18) = L, M, P, or R. Pegged orders may not be routable.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Limit price.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: A = Agency (maps to ’AOTC’) P = Principal (maps to ’DEAL’) R = Riskless (maps to ’MTCH’)

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: ISIN, or RIC if IDSource (22) is set.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: 1 = Buy 2 = Sell 5 = Sell Short 6 = Sell Short Exempt H = Sell Undisclosed

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Security symbol. See Symbology (p. 5) for additional notes.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: 0 = Day 1 = GTC (allowed, but treated as Day) 2 = AtTheOpen 3 = IOC (treated as Accept-Or-Cancel for RoutingInst (9303) = BP or BH) 6 = GTD (expires at earlier of specified ExpireTime (126) or end of day) 7 = AtTheClose 8 = Good For Auction (only valid if RoutingInst (9303) = BP or BU)

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time order initiated/released. Required by FIX 4.2 but not used by Cboe. Microsecond level resolution.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Optional minimum7 fill quantity for Cboe Only hidden, Cboe Dark Pool, Cboe Dark Periodic Sweep, Cboe Periodic Auction Book, Cboe Closing Cross or IOC orders. Rejected for Dark, Lit and Dark Lit Sweep Types. Ignored for other orders. Default is zero.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Portion of OrderQty (38) to display. The balance is reserve. 0 displays entire quantity (default). The displayed quantity of each order at a price level is decremented first. When displayed quantity is fully decremented, it is reloaded up to MaxFloor from reserve. May opt-in at the firm or port level to receive a restatement execution report on each reserve reload, allowing a Participant to know the new OrderID as represented on the Cboe market data feeds.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Required for TimeInForce (59) = 6 (GTD) orders, specifies the date and time (in GMT) that the order expires.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Required when IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN).

Field.Name: PegDifference
Field.Description: Optional signed value up to four decimal places8 is added to the result of peg calculation. Default is 0. Must be ≥ 0 for sell orders. Must be ≤ 0 for buy orders. Must be zero (or not specified) for midpoint peg or non-pegged orders.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: Firm that will clear trade. Optional. Note: shares storage with OnBehal- fOfCompID (115). If both fields are set, they must be equal.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Supplemental identifier. Optional. Recorded and returned in execution reports. Available via Drop. Note: shares storage with OnBehalfOfSubID (116). If both fields are set, then OnBehalfOfSubID (116) takes precedence for Service Bureau connections and ClearingAccount takes precedence for other connections.

Field.Name: OrderOrigination
Field.Description: 5 = DEA. Indicate DEA activity (as defined by MiFID II) is involved in the order. 0 = Non-DEA. (default) Other values are unsupported and will be rejected.

Field.Name: PreventParticipantMatch
Field.Description: Participant Trade Prevention: 3 characters (not space separated): 1st character - PTP Modifier: N = Cancel Newest O = Cancel Oldest B = Cancel Both D = Decrement Larger9 / Cancel Smaller d = Same as D above, but only decrement LeavesQty (151). Do not restate OrderQty (38). 2nd character - Unique ID Level: N = Do not prevent (Default value if not specified) F = Prevent Match at Participant Level M = Prevent Match at Trading Firm Level P = Prevent Match at Port Owner Level 3rd character - Trading Group ID (optional): Member specified alphanumeric value 0-9, A-Z, or a-z. The Unique ID level (character 2) of both orders must match to prevent a trade. If specified on both orders, Trading Group ID (character 3) must match to prevent a trade. The PTP Modifier (character 1) of the inbound order will be honored, except that if the inbound order specified Decrement and the resting order does not, and the resting order is larger, then both orders will be canceled. This exception is to protect the order entry software for the resting order from receiving an unexpected restatement message.

Field.Name: OrderAttributeTypes
Field.Description: Optional. This FIX tag can contain multiple values. If more than one value is present, they must be separated by spaces. The presence of a value means, for example, the order is an algorithmic order. The absence of a value indicates otherwise. Cboe supports the following values: 2 = Liquidity Provision activity order. This indicates the order is related to any sort of liquidity provision activity, as defined by MiFID II. This flag is mandatory for orders which are part of a liquidity provision activity. Absence of this value indicates otherwise. 4 = Algorithmic order. This indicates that the order was placed as a result of an investment firm engaging in algorithmic trading. Absence of this value indicates otherwise.

Field.Name: RoutingInst
Field.Description: Up-to 3 characters (not space separated): B = Cboe Only (default) P = Cboe Only — Post Only (will reject rather than remove visible liquidity) U = Dark Sweep (interbook) u = Dark Lit Sweep (best-price) W = Lit Sweep (interbook, best-price) X = Lit Sweep (interbook, sequential) BD = Cboe Dark Book Only (hidden midpoint peg orders only) BA = Cboe Automatic Dark Routed (routes to Cboe Integrated Book if order is Large In Scale (LIS) or is not a midpoint order, otherwise routes midpoint non-LIS orders to Cboe Dark Book) BP = Cboe Periodic Auction Book BH = Dark Periodic Sweep (midpoint peg orders) BU = Cboe Closing Cross An optional 3rd character can be used to specify Price Improvement for Cboe Periodic Auction Book (BP) limit orders only: N = None (implied if 3rd char is not specified) L = Limit (1-tick inside the limit price) T = Far-touch (least aggressive of 1-tick inside the EBBO far-touch or limit price) B = Both (least aggressive of 1-tick inside far-touch or 1-tick inside limit) Post Only does not mix with TimeInForce (59) = 3 (IOC). If a RoutingInst is not specified a default value of B is implied (Cboe Only).

Field.Name: DisplayIndicator
Field.Description: X = Displayed Order (default) I = Invisible Invisible orders must meet the MiFID requirements for Large in Scale (LIS) unless routed to the Cboe Dark Book.

Field.Name: OrigCompID
Field.Description: Drop only. TargetCompID (56) of original FIX execution report. Drop port must be configured to send this optional field.

Field.Name: OrigSubID
Field.Description: Drop only. TargetSubID (57) of original FIX execution report. Drop port must be configured to send this optional field.

Field.Name: RiskReset
Field.Description: For use by customers to reset or release clearing firm, symbol or Custom- GroupID (7699) level lockout conditions resulting from self-imposed lock- outs issued via Purge Request messages. Single Character Values: S = Symbol level lockout reset F = Clearing firm level lockout reset C = CustomGroupID lockout reset Values may be combined together to allow for resets of multiple self-imposed lockouts in a single message. For example, FS, SC, FC, and SFC are all acceptable values. If orders have been locked out at any level, inbound orders for the locked Symbol (55), clearing firm, or CustomGroupID (7699) will be rejected un- til this field is filled with the appropriate value on a New Order Single message.

Field.Name: CustomGroupID
Field.Description: Custom identifier for a group of orders.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Optional. Reflected back on Pending Cancel Execution Report or Cancel Reject associated with this cancel. 16 characters or less (ASCII 33–126). Configurably available via Drop.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Day-unique cancel ID chosen by client. 20 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33–126 are allowed, except for commma, semicolon, and pipe. Duplicate ClOrdIDs will be rejected (or ignored if PossResend (97) = Y.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Required if IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN). If Currency (15) is included when other symbology is used, it must match the currency expected by Cboe for the given symbol.

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Values supported by Cboe: 4 = ISIN 5 = RIC Required if Symbol (55) is not set.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Order identifier supplied by Cboe on the order acknowledgement. (Optional, but recommended for performance.)

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of shares for the order. Must match original order.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order to cancel.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: ISIN, or RIC if IDSource (22) is set.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: 1 = Buy 2 = Sell 5 = Sell Short 6 = Sell Short Exempt H = Sell Undisclosed

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Security symbol. See Symbology (p. 5) for additional notes.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time cancel initiated/released. Required by FIX 4.2 but not used by Cboe. Microsecond level resolution.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Required when IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN).

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Optional. Returned on execution reports associated with this order. 16 characters or less (ASCII 33–126). H: and C: prefix can be used to specify which CCP Account to use. If configured by Cboe: House or Client CCP account can be defaulted. OrderCapacity (47) is no longer used to determine which CCP account to use. The value supplied can be passed to the CCP and made available on the Drop feed.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Day-unique ID chosen by client. 20 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33–126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe. If the ClOrdID matches a live order, it will be rejected as duplicate (unless PossResend (97) = Y; see above). Note: Cboe only enforces the uniqueness of ClOrdID values among currently live orders. However, we strongly recommend that you keep your ClOrdID values day unique.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Required if IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN). If Currency (15) is included when other symbology is used, it must match the currency expected by Cboe for the given symbol.

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Values supported by Cboe: 4 = ISIN 5 = RIC Required if Symbol (55) is not set.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Order identifier supplied by Cboe on the order acknowledgement. In the case of multiple changes to a single order, this should be the OrderID from the most recent acknowledgement.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of shares for the order. This will modify the OrderQty of the current order, it does not directly set the remaining quantity.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: 1 = Market 2 = Limit P = Pegged During continuous trading Market (1) implies TimeInForce (59) = 3 (IOC). Pegged requires ExecInst (18) = L, M, P, or R. Pegged orders may not be routable.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order to replace. In the case of multiple changes to a single order, this will be the ClOrdID of the most recently accepted change.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Limit price.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: ISIN, or RIC if IDSource (22) is set.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: 1 = Buy 2 = Sell 5 = Sell Short 6 = Sell Short Exempt H = Sell Undisclosed

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Security symbol. See Symbology (p. 5) for additional notes.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time cancel/replace initiated/released. Required by FIX 4.2 but not used by Cboe. Microsecond level resolution.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Required when IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN).

Field.Name: CancelOrigOnReject
Field.Description: N = Leave original order alone (default) Y = Cancel original order if replacement fails Default may be configured per port.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Copied from order, if present. (Available on Drop via optional port config- uration)

Field.Name: AvgPx
Field.Description: Average fill price.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order being accepted, executed, or rejected. –or– ClOrdID of the cancel or replace request. –or– ClOrdID of the order subject to unsolicited cancel (OrigClOrdID (41) will not be present).

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: Cumulative quantity of shares executed for this order.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Copied from order, if present.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Day-unique ID of execution message.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Copied from order, if present.

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: 0 = New

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Copied from order, if present.

Field.Name: LastCapacity
Field.Description: Broker capacity in order execution. 1 = Agent (maps to ’AOTC’) 3 = Cross as Principal (maps to ’MTCH’) 4 = Principal (maps to ’DEAL’)

Field.Name: LastMkt
Field.Description: Populated with the segment MIC of this fill.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this fill (zero for non-fills).

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of shares traded on this fill (zero for non-fills).

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Order identifier supplied by Cboe.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: State of order. 0 = New 1 = Partially Filled 2 = Filled 4 = Canceled 5 = Replaced 6 = Pending Cancel 8 = Rejected A = Pending Ack E = Pending Replace

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order being canceled or replaced (for a solicited cancel or cancel/replace, otherwise not present).

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Copied from order, if present.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Copied from order or trade report.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Copied from order, if present.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: If present, indicates reason for the message. Format is one letter reason code followed by colon and space followed by free form text message. Reason codes are: A = Admin D = Duplicate ClOrdID H = Halted K = Order Rate Threshold Exceeded k = Pending periodic auction (BXE and DXE only) L = Price Exceeds Cross Range N = Ran Out of Liquidity to Execute Against O = ClOrdID Doesn’t Match a Known Order P = Can’t Modify an Order That is Pending Fill Q = Waiting For First Trade R = Routing Unavailable T = Routing order would trade through an away destination U = User Requested V = Would Wash W = Add Liquidity Only Order Would Remove X = Order Expired Y = Symbol Not Supported Z = Unforseen Reason l = Large in Scale r = Reserve Reload m = Market Access Risk Limit Exceeded o = Max Open Orders Count Exceeded p = Static Collar Breach s = Symbol Level Risk Management v = MiFID II Double Cap related

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time transaction occurred. Microsecond level resolution.

Field.Name: SettlType
Field.Description: Drop only. Only relevant if ExecType (150) = F and the original trade report utilised a non-standard settlement date. In this case, the relevant date will also be included in SettlDate (64).

Field.Name: SettlDate
Field.Description: Drop only. Only relevant if ExecType (150) = F and the original trade report utilised SettlType (63)̸ = 0, in which case, the relevant date will be included in SettlDate (64); or, if the original trade report specified a SettlDate (64).

Field.Name: OrdRejReason
Field.Description: Optionally set when ExecType (150) = 8 (Rejected). 0 = Broker Option 1 = Unknown Symbol 2 = Exchange Closed 3 = Order Exceeds Limit 5 = Unknown Order 6 = Duplicate Order 8 = Stale Order

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Copied from order if TimeInForce (59) = 6 (GTD).

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Reason for this execution report. 0 = New (acknowledgement of new order) 1 = Partial Fill 2 = Fill 4 = Canceled 5 = Replaced 8 = Rejected D = Restated For Drop only, if optionally configured, the following value is also supported: F = Trade

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Quantity of shares still open for further execution. Will be zero if order is dead, otherwise will be OrderQty − CumQty. Note: It is possible for LeavesQty to be zero when ExecType (150) = 5 indicating that the order is dead.

Field.Name: SecondaryOrderID
Field.Description: Must request opt-in at firm or port level to receive this field. Present on Prevent Participant Match triggered cancel/restatement. De- notes the Cboe OrderID (37) of contra side of prevented match. Present on a restatement execution report for reload of a reserve (iceberg) order. Denotes the new Cboe OrderID which will be present on the Cboe market data feeds.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Copied from order, if present.

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: Only present on trades. Indicates the market of execution. Markets are identified by their ISO Market Identification Code (MIC)1011

Field.Name: ExecRestatementReason
Field.Description: Required when ExecType (150) = D (Restated). 4 = Broker option; optionally sent during reload of a reserve (iceberg) order. 5 = Partial decline of OrderQty

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: Only present on trades. Always 1.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: Copied from order, if present.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Copied from order, if present.

Field.Name: SettlPrice
Field.Description: Drop only. Only relevant if ExecType (150) = F and the original trade report utilised SettlPrice (730). This represents the price at which the trade will settle.

Field.Name: OrderOrigination
Field.Description: 5 = DEA. Indicate DEA activity (as defined by MiFID II) is involved in the order. 0 = Non-DEA. (default) Other values are unsupported and will be rejected.

Field.Name: CentralCounterparty
Field.Description: Only present on trades. The CCP handling the trade: EMCF = EuroCCP LCHL = LCH Ltd (London) LCHS = LCH SA (Paris) XCLR = SIX x-clear NONE = Clearing Suppressed Returned on trades if the participant has selected a Preferred CCP. The FIX port can be configured to always return this optional field.

Field.Name: TrdRegPublicationReasons
Field.Description: If present, indicates the post-trade waiver derived by Cboe for this trade. Valid values are: 4 = Pre-Trade Transparency Waiver for Illiquid Instrument (for SI only) (ILQD) 5 = Pre-Trade Transparency Waiver for Above Standard Market Size (for SI only) (SIZE) Pre-Trade Transparency Waivers ILQD and SIZE can be requested individu- ally or together by specifying one ore more value separated by a space (e.g. 4 5). Based upon what is requested, the system calculates which of these are valid. The business confirmation contains the waiver(s) that have been appplied.

Field.Name: OrderAttributeTypes
Field.Description: Optional. This FIX tag can contain multiple values. If more than one value is present, they must be separated by spaces. The presence of a value means, for example, the order is an algorithmic order. The absence of a value indicates otherwise. Cboe supports the following values: 2 = Liquidity Provision activity order. This indicates the order is related to any sort of liquidity provision activity, as defined by MiFID II. This flag is mandatory for orders which are part of a liquidity provision activity. Absence of this value indicates otherwise. 4 = Algorithmic order. This indicates that the order was placed as a result of an investment firm engaging in algorithmic trading. Absence of this value indicates otherwise.

Field.Name: TradeLiquidityIndicator
Field.Description: Only present on trades. A = Added Liquidity R = Removed Liquidity AD = Added Liquidity for the Cboe Dark Pool RD = Removed Liquidity from the Cboe Dark Pool RT = Removed Liquidity from the Cboe Dark Pool by IOC order AI = Added Hidden Liquidity that was price improved AK = Added Liquidity from the hidden (reserve) portion of an iceberg order AS = Added Liquidity A-LPS BBO Setter RS = Removed Liquidity from A-LPS BBO Setter X = Routed to Another Market C = Auction CC = Cboe Closing Cross P = Periodic Auction S = Self Match (opt-in) SD = Self Match from the Cboe Dark Pool (opt-in) To allow for future expansion of this field, please ignore values with an unknown character in the 2nd position.

Field.Name: FeeCode
Field.Description: Specific fee code associated with the trade. See the Fee Schedule for the respective market for possible values.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Copied from Cancel or Cancel/Replace request.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID from the Cancel or Cancel/Replace request.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: OrderID of the order that failed to be canceled or replaced. NONE if CxlRejReason (102) = 1 (Unknown Order).

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: State of order that failed to be canceled or replaced.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order that failed to be canceled or replaced.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free-form text message.

Field.Name: CxlRejReason
Field.Description: 0 = Too Late to Cancel 1 = Unknown Order 3 = Already Pending Cancel or Pending Replace

Field.Name: CxlRejResponseTo
Field.Description: 1 = Cancel 2 = Cancel/Replace

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order whose trade is being canceled or corrected.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Copied from order if IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN).

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Day-unique ID of execution message.

Field.Name: ExecRefID
Field.Description: Refers to the ExecID (17) of the execution being canceled or corrected.

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: 1 = Cancel 2 = Correct

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Copied from order being canceled or corrected, if present.

Field.Name: LastMkt
Field.Description: LastMkt on the original trade being canceled or corrected, if the port is configured to send this tag.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price on the original trade being canceled or corrected.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of shares on the original trade being canceled or corrected.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: OrderID of the order whose trade is being canceled or corrected.

Field.Name: OrigTime
Field.Description: Date and time of the original trade, in GMT. Microsecond level resolution.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Copied from original order being canceled or corrected if IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN), or 5 (RIC) was used.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Copied from trade being canceled or corrected.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Copied from original order being canceled or corrected.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Date and time of the cancel or correction. Microsecond level resolution.

Field.Name: SettlType
Field.Description: Drop only. SettlType on the original trade being canceled or corrected, if relevant.

Field.Name: SettlDate
Field.Description: Drop only. SettlDate on the original trade being canceled or corrected, if relevant.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Copied from order being canceled or corrected if IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN) was used.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: Copied from trade being canceled or corrected, if present.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Copied from trade being canceled or corrected, if present.

Field.Name: SettlPrice
Field.Description: Drop only. SettlPrice on the original trade being canceled or corrected, if relevant.

Field.Name: CorrectedSize
Field.Description: The corrected size of the trade. Only set if ExecTransType (20) = 2 (Trade Correct).

Field.Name: CorrectedPrice
Field.Description: The corrected price of the trade. Only set if ExecTransType (20) = 2 (Trade Correct).

Field.Name: TradeLiquidityIndicator
Field.Description: Copied from trade being canceled or corrected.

Field.Name: PartyID
Field.Description: The short code representing the client or decision maker represented by this block. Unsigned numerical only. Data corresponding to this short code must have been previously supplied, or will be supplied by the end of the calendar day, per our Rules. For clients, the following values are reserved for applicable use: Applicable to PartyRole value 3: 0 = NONE (No Client for this order) 1 = AGGR (An aggregation of multiple client orders) 2 = PNAL (Clients are pending allocation) Applicable to PartyRole value 12: 3 = NORE (Timing and location of the execution determined by the client of the Participant)

Field.Name: PartyIDSource
Field.Description: Must always be P (Short code identifier)

Field.Name: PartyRole
Field.Description: Specifies the role of the party to the trade. At this time, only the following values are valid: 3 = Client ID 12 = Executing Trader (the Executing Decision Maker) 122 = Investor ID (the Investment Decision Maker)

Field.Name: PartyRoleQualifier
Field.Description: Provides further qualification of the PartyRole value. Valid values are: 0 = None (applicable only for the reserved Party IDs) 22 = Algorithm (applicable to PartyRole values 12 or 122) 23 = Firm or legal entity (LEI) (applicable to PartyRole value 3) 24 = Natural person (applicable to PartyRole values 3, 12 and 122)
